app.title: qpwgraph-rs
cli.lang: set the UI language (en or es)
cli.demo: use the deterministic demo backend instead of PipeWire
status.demo_ready: Demo backend ready — click a source port, then a sink port to connect
status.backend_unavailable: No live graph backend available — start PipeWire or use --demo
status.pipewire_ready: Connected to PipeWire — click a source port, then a sink port to connect
status.alsa_ready: Connected to ALSA MIDI — click a source port, then a sink port to connect
status.activated: Patchbay activated: {connected} connected, {present} already present, {disconnected} disconnected
relay.title: Audio relay
relay.refresh_help: Search the network again for relay hosts
relay.advanced_help: Defaults suit most networks; change these only when a link needs it.
relay.level_tip: Incoming audio level for this session
relay.no_peers: No relay hosts found yet. Keep this panel open while the host advertises.
relay.emitter_hint: Starting the host broadcasts this device's audio; receivers connect with your address and PIN.
relay.discovery_help: Hosts announce themselves over mDNS (_qpw-relay._udp) and are probed directly on USB tether links. Keep both devices on the same network while discovery runs.
relay.quick_target_help: host:port, or a pasted qpw-relay:// QR payload.
relay.qr_hint: Scan with the Android app to fill in the address and PIN automatically.
relay.qr_unavailable: No QR yet: start the host and make sure this device has a local IPv4 network link.
relay.qr_no_link: No local IPv4 link detected; the QR appears as soon as one is available.
relay.no_links: No local IPv4 link detected; the QR and endpoint list stay empty until one appears.
relay.unavailable: Audio relay requires the native PipeWire backend.
relay.pin_help: Six-digit PIN shared with the peer.
relay.port_help: TCP port; 0 selects an available port.
relay.target_help: Use host:port, for example 192.168.1.20:48123, or paste a qpw-relay:// QR payload.
relay.role_help: Choose whether this client emits, receives, or carries both directions.
relay.codec_help: Opus is recommended for network audio; PCM is useful for diagnostics.
relay.transport_help: Auto selects the best local link and detects USB tethering automatically; explicit choices require that link.
help.history: Show undoable and redoable actions separately.
help.save_patchbay: Write the current saved patchbay rules to disk.
help.load_patchbay: Read patchbay rules from the configured file.
help.snapshot: Replace the saved patchbay rules with the links currently visible.
help.activate: Apply saved patchbay rules to the live graph.
help.disconnect_all: Disconnect every live link as one undoable action.
search.help: Filter nodes and ports by name.
help.navigation_graph: Inspect the live graph and layout.
help.navigation_preferences: Configure language, interface, behavior, and patchbay options.
help.navigation_relay: Broadcast audio as an emitter or connect to a host as a receiver.
preferences.title: Preferences
screen.graph_hint: Inspect nodes, ports, links, and layout.
screen.patchbay_hint: Save and activate persistent connection rules.
inspector.no_live_links: No active links are currently visible.
inspector.configuration_hint: Hover an icon or option for an explanation.
sort.name: Name
language.label: Language
help.configuration: Application options and filters are saved automatically after changes. Patchbay link files still use explicit save actions.
help.save_configuration: Force-save the current application options and filters immediately.
help.language: Choose the interface language. The choice is saved for the next launch.
help.exclusive: Remove live links that are not present in the saved patchbay when activating.
help.auto_disconnect: Disconnect another link to the same sink before creating a saved connection.
help.auto_pin: Mark newly created connections as pinned in the saved patchbay.
help.patchbay_activated: Automatically activate the saved patchbay after startup.
help.toolbar_visible: Show refresh, undo, redo, and other common graph actions in the sidebar.
help.statusbar_visible: Show connection status and backend information at the bottom.
help.patchbay_toolbar_visible: Show save, load, snapshot, and activate patchbay actions in the sidebar.
help.repel_overlaps: Move overlapping nodes apart automatically while the graph is idle.
help.connect_through: Click a node body to connect to its first compatible sink port.
help.connect_mode_easy: Easy mode: drag one node onto another to connect every matching pair of ports at once (e.g. both stereo channels). Click to switch to Advanced.
help.connect_mode_advanced: Advanced mode: drag from one specific port to another to create a single connection. Click to switch to Easy, whole-node dragging.
help.thumbnail_view: Show compact node cards without ports or link lines.
help.sort_ports: Order each node's ports by name or by their native numeric ID.
help.media_filter: Show only nodes and ports in the selected media category. MIDI includes PipeWire/JACK and ALSA MIDI.
help.minimap: Show or hide an overview of every node and link in the graph.
help.arrange_nodes: Arrange nodes by media category and connection direction. Saved positions are replaced.
history.title: Action history
history.hint: Actions are separated into undoable and redoable entries.
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.hint: Press F1 to toggle this help. Shortcuts are disabled while typing in a text field.
shortcuts.search_hint: Filter by key or description… (Ctrl/Cmd+F focuses this field)
shortcuts.help: Show or hide this shortcuts window
shortcuts.close_cancel: Close help or cancel the current graph action
shortcuts.arrange: Arrange nodes by media and direction
shortcuts.pan_keyboard: Pan the graph with arrow keys (Shift faster, Ctrl/Cmd fastest)
help.ui_text_scale: Scale toolbar, status bar, and other application chrome text.
help.panel_text_scale: Scale navigation and Preferences panel text without changing graph node labels.
help.node_text_scale: Scale node titles, port labels, and node counters without changing panel text.
help.typography_controls: Use ↑/↓ or the step buttons. Values are limited to 0.80–2.00 in 0.05 steps.
help.typography_recommended: Set a more readable size balance for the application, panels, and graph nodes.
help.audio_monitor_unpin: Remove the pinned audio monitor from this panel.
help.audio_metering_policy: Metering attaches a capture stream to a node, which can resume a suspended device and make PipeWire renegotiate the graph rate. On demand measures the audio nodes shown while this window is visible.
help.audio_reset: Release every metering stream so PipeWire can suspend the nodes again and restore their configured settings.
meters.off_hint: No metering streams are ever created.
meters.on_demand_hint: Streams stay active for the audio nodes shown while this window is visible.
meters.always_hint: Every audio node is measured continuously. This keeps devices awake.
canvas.drag_header: Drag this header to move the node.
canvas.drag_body_connect: Drag the body onto another node to connect all matching ports.
canvas.output_help: Click or drag from this port, then choose a compatible input.
canvas.input_help: Choose this port after selecting an output to create a connection.
canvas.output_group_help: Click or drag from this group, then choose a compatible group of inputs. Connects every channel at once.
canvas.input_group_help: Choose this group after selecting an output group to connect every channel at once.
canvas.disconnect_node: Disconnect all links from this node
canvas.disconnect_node_easy: Disconnect all channel groups from this node
canvas.disconnect_node_advanced: Disconnect all individual links from this node
canvas.audio_controls_unavailable: Audio controls are unavailable for this node.
canvas.audio_meter_unavailable: Live level data is not available for this port.
canvas.audio_meter_disabled: Metering is off. Enable it in Preferences to read levels.
effects.title: Effects
effects.add_help: Browse the effect gallery and add a connectable node.
effects.gallery_hint: Choose an effect to create a new node you can connect on the canvas.
effects.backend_unavailable: The active backend cannot host effect nodes yet.
effects.create_node_hint: Add input and output ports, then connect them on the canvas.
effects.insert_link_hint: Replace one direct link with source → effect → destination.
effects.choose_effect_hint: Select a built-in or discovered effect to insert.
effects.choose_link_hint: The effect will be inserted between the source and destination.
effects.setup_hint: Review the settings before creating the effect node.
effects.no_audio_links: Create or select an audio link first.
effects.back_help: Return to the previous setup step.
effects.not_found: Effect node is no longer available
effects.link_unavailable: The selected link is no longer available
effects.audio_only: Effects can only be inserted on audio links
effects.created: Effect node created — connect its input and output ports on the canvas
effects.inserted: Effect inserted into the audio link
